title: SoundGate Guitar
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
gap: Every big guitar app (Yousician, Simply Guitar, Fender Play) sells a curriculum and grades you against ITS songs. Nobody grades you against the song you already chose to learn — the one you looked up a tab for last night. The listening layer is finally cheap enough to be decoupled from the course.

zh.gap: 大厂吉他 App（Yousician / Simply Guitar / Fender Play）卖的是课程，只拿它自己的曲库给你打分。没有人对着「你昨晚自己搜到那份谱」打分。而听力这一层现在便宜到可以从课程里拆出来单卖。

voices.quote: I would love to have an instructor, Rocksmith can teach things but It can't see my hooftips and coach me in not sucking.
voices.zh: 我真希望能有个老师。Rocksmith 能教一些东西，但它看不见我的指尖，也没法教我别弹得那么难听。

voices.quote: I realised the g sting is the only one which isn't giving crisp sound. All other gives. How important is it that the g string gives crisp sound? Should I change my hand placement or continue with my current hand placement. I have no teacher.
voices.zh: 我发现只有 G 弦声音不干净，别的弦都没问题。G 弦一定要发音干净吗？我该改一下手的位置，还是就这么练下去？

voices.quote: Palm muting. Am I doing this right? Maybe not great amp settings?
voices.zh: 闷音（palm muting）。我这么弹对吗？也许是音箱设置不对？

zh.pain: 买了吉他、跟着 YouTube 学会四个和弦然后卡住的成年人——因为没人在旁边告诉他「那根弦你按闷了」。
zh.kill: 扫弦六根弦的音高识别是真难，几家老牌在音频工程上磨了很多年；随便包一层通用 pitch 库，用户第一节课就听得出它判错，然后再也不打开。
zh.move: 不要做课程，只做那只耳朵：对准学习者本来就打开着的任何一份谱或教学视频，只告诉他哪一小节反复弹错。冷启动：中文＝小红书/B站「吉他自学」打卡帖的评论区（人们在那里贴自己的录音求点评）；英文＝r/guitarlessons 每周的 critique-my-playing 帖。

pain: Adults teaching themselves guitar from an app hit the same wall on day thirty: the app can play at them but cannot look at them. They post a phone video to strangers and wait a day to find out whether their hand is in the wrong place.
kill: Pitch detection on a strummed six-string chord is genuinely hard, and the incumbents have had years of audio engineering on it; a thin wrapper over a generic pitch library will be heard as wrong within one session and never opened again.
move: Don't ship a course. Ship the ear: point it at any tab or YouTube lesson the learner already has open, and just tell them which bar they keep fluffing. Cold start CN = 小红书/B站 '吉他自学' 打卡帖下面的评论区 (人们在那里贴自己的录音求点评); EN = r/guitarlessons weekly 'critique my playing' threads.
